copy.tagline: 用 Supabase 快速搭建后端服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Supabase 构建应用后端
copy.tagline_en: Build backend services quickly with Supabase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app backend with Supabase

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Supabase 搭建后端，包括数据库、用户登录、实时更新、文件存储和边缘函数。它会生成类型安全的代码，并强制开启行级安全。
howto.when: 当你提到 Supabase、createClient、RLS、实时订阅、存储或边缘函数等关键词，或要求设置后端服务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Supabase 创建一个用户登录功能，用邮箱和密码。
为我的博客表写一个 RLS 策略，只允许已登录用户查看已发布的文章。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 SQL 策略。

say.text: 设置一个 Supabase 实时订阅，监听 messages 表的插入事件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you build a backend with Supabase: database, authentication, realtime subscriptions, file storage, and edge functions. It generates type-safe code and enforces Row Level Security.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Supabase, createClient, RLS, realtime, storage, edge functions, or ask to set up a backend service.

say_en.text: Create a Supabase login feature with email and password.
Write an RLS policy for my blog table so only logged-in users can see published posts.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the SQL policy.

say_en.text: Set up a Supabase realtime subscription for inserts on the messages table.
